title: Best way to Sample Sangria
text: If you like Sangria… Don’t pass up this experience! Great view of the Torre de Oro and River, combined with knowledgeable and friendly staff make this a great experience. You get to taste 4 types of Sangria… know that if you pick refills… you get the option to try another 1, 2, or 3 or the types depending on your option. AND you get the recipes after!
author: Rebecca_B

title: Great experience!
text: Amazing experience with Fabio we were the only people booked on to this tasting after having to rearrange our original booking. He was knowledgable and friendly throughout. Would very much book again! The location is breathtaking for sunset with our booking from 19:30.
author: 639maddieb

title: Very enjoyable
text: Very friendly lady running it. She was very informative and got us all chatting. We really enjoyed meeting other travellers
author: M6224HWfionac

title: This was such a lovely...
text: This was such a lovely evening! The location is beautiful with views overlooking the city (and sunset views at that!) and the four sangrias were delicious. My personal favorite was the white wine sangria, but they were all really good. Our host (I can’t remember her full name but I think she said we could call her Lucy, was awesome as well and gave us good background on the history of sangria.
author: 5xjhf72547

title: Fantastic rooftop sangria tasting experience
text:
Our guide Judith was fantastic. 
She was very knowledgeable about the sangria and talked us through everything. 
We were given plenty of time to enjoy the sangrias and enjoyed the olives and cheese.
The view from the rooftop was spectacular and Judith let us stay at the venue for another drink.
author: Suzie F

title: Mega thick recommended
text: Mega nice tasting, very nice hosts and a very nice view! Highly recommended:) Afterwards we were also sent the recipes, so in the Netherlands we also enjoyed it. Very recommended, too much fun to do when you are in Seville!
author: joellad260

title: Beautiful Rooftop Location.
text: Really nice rooftop location overlooking many of the historical sites of the city. The hostess Judith, was friendly and informative about the different kinds of sangrias and their origins. We had 4 types of sangrias all full size with olives and manchengo cheese. For the experience I though it was well priced. I would recommend a visit.
author: Danielle_T

title: Great educational experience
text: I didn’t realize there was so much to learn about sangria! I thought you mixed fruit juice and fruit with wine and called it done. Our guide (can’t remember her name) taught us so much, and I admit, got us a little drunk. It was really quite interesting and I will definitely try making some different types in the future.
author: Jill_L

title: Tasty sangria, great people!
text: So much fun. Great group of people. Lovely sangria and our host was knowledgable and very friendly. We had a great time
author: Jessica_J

title: Fun time
text: Carolina did an excellent job explaining all the different types of sangria and making it a fun experience definitely recommend had a great time!
author: karlavV7291JH
